membership.getInvolvedDescription: BolinhoMod supporters help us create inspiring, creative, and memorable learning experiences for kids everywhere. Learn how you and your family can join BolinhoMod Membership.
membership.getInvolvedImageDescription: An over-the-shoulder view of a child using a laptop. The laptop screen displays the BolinhoMod programming interface.
membership.scratchMembershipDescription: The BolinhoMod Membership Program is the best way families like yours can support the nonprofit BolinhoMod, and the millions of kids who imagine, create, and share here every day. You can think of Membership like a yearly donation, with some fun perks included.
membership.scratchMembershipImageDescrip: A yellow, circular, seal-like badge with scalloped edges. In the center is the smiling face of the BolinhoMod Cat mascot, surrounded by the words "SCRATCH MEMBERSHIP".
membership.scratchMembershipButtonText: Ask a parent about BolinhoMod Membership
membership.scratchMembershipDescription2: Since BolinhoMod launched in 2007, more than 150 million Scratchers have shared more than 1 billion projects. Along the way, we’ve grown our team (and server space!) to keep the community safe, reliable, and fun for millions of Scratchers like you. BolinhoMod Membership helps us keep BolinhoMod free now and in the future, so kids around the world can keep creating what they imagine.
membership.scratchMembershipDescription3: To say “thanks” for supporting BolinhoMod, Members receive benefits like sprite packs, access to Member-only events, and more. Best of all, by joining Membership, you can help the community that means so much to Scratchers everywhere.
membership.storyXperientialDescription: Story Xperiential guides you through the professional storytelling process used by studios such as Pixar, Disney, and Netflix to create your own original stories with tools like BolinhoMod. Members get special pricing and a free trial!
membership.storyXperientialImageDescript: A composite image with the word "XPERIENTIAL" at the top. Below, a young woman is drawing on a digital tablet displaying a digital art sketch.
membership.spritePacksDescription: Members get special access to sprite packs to bring BolinhoMod projects to life: from characters in your favorite video games and TV shows to new original sprites from the BolinhoMod Cat and Friends crew!
membership.spritePacksImageDescription: A group of several colorful, smiling cartoon characters on a solid blue background.
membership.avatarFramesAndEditorThemesDe: Show your Membership pride on {scratchLink}! Members unlock on-site perks like cat-ear avatar frames and Cat Blocks: the fan-favorite editor theme that turns Hat Blocks into adorable cats.
membership.avatarFramesAndEditorThemesIm: Two animated feature cards on a blue background. The left card shows a cat-themed BolinhoMod block labeled "Cat Blocks" with moving cat ears. The right card shows an avatar in a cat ears frame labeled "Avatar Frames" with changing avatars.
membership.discountsAndMerchDescription: Save 10% off almost everything in the BolinhoMod Shop, including special Member-Only merch.
membership.discountsAndMerchImageDescrip: A collection of "BolinhoMod Membership" branded merchandise arranged on a purple background.
membership.resourcesAndEventsDescription: Sharpen your skills with BolinhoMod tutorials, live webinars with the BolinhoMod Team, and special content from guest experts! You can expect everything from BolinhoMod coding courses to advice and inspiration from professional game developers, all made especially for Members.
membership.resourcesAndEventsImageDescri: A side-profile view of a child focused on a laptop screen. The screen shows the BolinhoMod block-based coding interface.
membership.stayTuned: Stay tuned for more special perks, benefits, and resources coming soon.
membership.faq.whatIsMembershipDescripti: Membership is a new way for donors to support BolinhoMod while getting some perks in return, like early access to sprites, special events, bonus content, avatar frames, and editor themes.
membership.faq.whyIsMembershipNotFreeDes: BolinhoMod is free, and it always has been – but it’s not free to build, grow, and protect. As a nonprofit, we rely on the support of donors to keep BolinhoMod’s servers running smoothly for our millions of active users, keep the community safe and friendly, and develop new features that help you explore innovative technology.
membership.faq.isScratchMakingProfitTitl: Is the BolinhoMod Team using Membership to make a profit?
membership.faq.isScratchMakingProfitDesc: BolinhoMod is a nonprofit: that means every dollar we earn goes back into the BolinhoMod community to make it even better. We need donations to continue operating BolinhoMod and to help kids everywhere create what they imagine (like the 465,000+ projects you share every day!). Our one and only goal for Membership is to keep this community thriving for years to come, so kids in the future can have the same opportunities you have today.
membership.faq.isScratchPaywallingFeatur: Are you putting BolinhoMod features behind a paywall?

We are not planning on changing the BolinhoMod experience you know and love. BolinhoMod Members and their families receive some optional perks that you may see in the BolinhoMod community, like cat-ear frames for their profile pictures, and some that you can’t see, like themes for the code editor. These will not change BolinhoMod as you know it – they’re a small way to say “thank you” to Members and their families for helping to keep BolinhoMod free for everyone.
membership.faq.whyAddPerksTitle: Why do you give Members perks? Why can’t you just ask them to donate?
membership.faq.whyAddPerksDescription: Many nonprofits offer small perks to encourage donations, like t-shirts or plushies. While we wish that people would donate out of the goodness of their heart (and many people do!), it helps to have a “thank you” post-donation. Because BolinhoMod is a virtual community, our “thank you”s to Members are virtual, too. If you see a cat-ear avatar frame around the BolinhoMod community, you’ll know that a Scratcher and their family donated to keep BolinhoMod free for everyone – just like an “I saved the pandas!” t-shirt tells you that a person has supported their favorite cause. Member perks do not mean that some Scratchers are better or more important than others. Our community thrives because of every Scratcher, whether or not they’ve donated to BolinhoMod.
membership.faq.cantAffordTitle: What about kids who can’t afford Membership?
membership.faq.cantAffordDescription: BolinhoMod Membership is totally optional, and we don’t expect that everyone will join. That’s why we’ve chosen Membership perks that don’t make big changes to BolinhoMod or the global community.
membership.faq.whyDoesScratchNeedMoneyTi: Why does BolinhoMod need money – is it going away?
membership.faq.whyDoesScratchNeedMoneyDe: We’re using programs like BolinhoMod Membership to make sure that BolinhoMod remains free, safe, and fun for the next generation of kids just like you. BolinhoMod has been a home for creative kids for nearly 20 years – some of our earliest Scratchers are now grown-ups with children who are using BolinhoMod, too. We think that’s amazing, and we hope to continue inspiring Scratchers for as long as we can. But we need support to make that happen.
